name: Bob
houseDescription: Kiddie and pastel items with a loose, cluttered charm — feels lived-in and silly.
description: Legendary lazy cat with the meme catchphrase everyone quotes—naps, snacks, and a goofy grin that never goes out of style.

seo.title: Bob — Lazy cat
seo.description: Bob the lazy cat in Animal Crossing—meme-famous catchphrase, cozy nap energy, and island charm that fans still adore.

acnh.intro: Bob is a lazy cat villager in the who appears in all games to date. His name may be derived from. His Japanese catchphrase, ''neko'', means "cat," relating to his species. According to series co-creator Hisashi Nogami, Bob was the first villager created, and his January 1 birthday came as a result of that.
acnh.appearance: Bob is a lavender cat dotted in deeper purple spots, with half-closed lazy yellow eyes and pale purple paws. Pink fills the inside of his ears, and his tail stripes alternate purple shades like a cozy quilt.
acnh.personality: Bob's lazy rhythm makes every day feel unhurried — friendly hellos, food on the mind, and humor that lands softly. He meshes well with peppy, smug, and cranky neighbors, though snooty and jock villagers may side-eye his snack-and-nap lifestyle. Sleep finds him at eleven; he wakes at eight with the same mellow energy that made him a fan favorite for decades.

villagerInfo.quote: You only live once...or nine times.
